events.title: Rhythm Game Arcade
events.description: Enjoy free-play style rhythm games set up by UCSD's Dance and Rhythm Game Club! We'll have DDR, Pump it Up, Taiko no Tatsujin, SDVX, Wacca, Chunithm, and Sound Voltex~

events.title: Closet Cosplay 101
events.description: Cosplay is something that can be fun and accessible to everyone! And some don't need super advanced skills like or lots of expensive materials to create a good cosplay! Some can even be made with some extra cash on the side, time, and effort! Learn how to make a cosplay right from your closet! With or without basic skills like painting, sewing, or even thrifting on the weekends!

events.title: Sketchbook Swap
events.description: Sketchbooks moving all round! Artists and more welcome to come in and trade sketchbooks! Share your drawings, and leave a memory for other members of the con to take home and enjoy!

events.title: Make a Furry Rave Hangout Game on Roblox
events.description:
10 min: Introduction and Logistics
50 min: Presentation
10 min: Q&A (If we are able to get guest speakers)
60 min: Panel with Roblox Devs

events.title: Getting Unstuck in Life: The Science behind Behavioral Change and How Coaches can Help
events.host: Slyde, the Furry Health & Wellness Coach
events.description: Making changes to your life can be scary, but you don't have to do it alone! Come join and learn about the emerging field of coaching, the science behind behavioral change, and how YOU could make changes in your own life to live the life you want.

events.title: Cinema Screams Jeopardy!
events.description: Welcome to everyone's favorite game show! Now with a special Howloween Twist too it as we bring out fun Trivia that the audience will split into teams for, and compete to win prizes based on who's collected the most throughout the game! Think you know your horror trivia? From Famous films, to actors, shows and even more unexpected elements... Get ready to pick your brain before the horde arrives for it first.

events.title: Special Guest Meet & Greet and Q&A Sponsor Panel
events.description: A private panel for our Special Guests and our con sponsors, as an added perk to being a sponsor for this event, You'll get to meet this years special guests, get to ask questions, and get to really know who our special guests are and how much they mean to Triton Tails and the furry community as a whole!

events.title: University Meetup
events.description: University Furs from far and wide all come tonight to this spot! Whether youre a UC Student, CSU, Private or Public University, or even coming from universities far and wide all over and beyond California, nows your chance to meet up with other university students, make connections, network and lots lots more! You'll never know who you can find and what connections you can make here, you might even be meeting your future coworkers here!

events.title: Furry Mahjong
events.description: Come learn how to play Japanese Mahjong (Riichi) with furries!

events.title: Jojo's Anthropomorphic Adventure: Guessing Tendency
events.description: Guess the Jojo’s Bizarre Adventure character and the animal they're based on to score points! Top 3 (with tie-breakers) win custom art!

events.title: Costume/Fursuit Figure Drawing Class
events.description: Hello artist! For today's class we're drawing 10 volunteers from different angles to create a rotoscope animation. It will be divided into two sessions so that you can go back to experiencing Howloween (5:30-6:30pm, 6:30-7:30pm). Paper and pencil will be provided, and you can see the animation on the Triton Tails discord server! Volunteer applications close an hour prior to the panel. Interested volunteers can apply using the form linked below!

events.title: The Descendants Panel
events.description: Join Arai as they speak about the worldbuilding and international implications of the Disney Descendants franchise.

events.title: Horror in Music
events.description: While not as prominent a theme in music compared to other genres, horror is still a prominent part of many horror artists. From campy theatrics to cold nihilistic dread, themes of terror have pervaded our music in many ways. Join me through a musical journey, where we analyze how 5 music artists convey fear.

events.title: THE KARAOKE THEATER
events.description: Come join and sing your heart out for two hours at this karaoke panel! Featuring your most fab and karaoke diva Panda from San Diego Furries. No professional vocals needed, no spectacular stage presence needed; just get on the stage and SING!!!

events.title: Real Big Top!
events.description: ITS TIME FOR SOME REAL BIG CLOWNING! With their Alternative Clown Music, You'd think the circus was in town, because it is! Live Today at Howloween! Catch the various acts and talents and clownings at Howloween!

events.description: Yapping his way all across the nation, Yammo The Yeen brings the comedy from cons across the globe to here at UC San Diego for the first time! Catch the Comediyeen's Exclusive UC San Diego Show here at Howloween!
